allow: PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:4000/game/" -UseBasicParsing; echo "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:4000/assets/js/game.js" -UseBasicParsing; echo "JS: $\($r2.StatusCode\) len=$\($r2.Content.Length\)")

PowerShell($hub = Get-Content _site\\game\\index.html -Raw; $cards = \([regex]::Matches\($hub, 'class="post-card"'\)\).Count; echo "Hub cards: $cards"; $pages = Get-ChildItem _site\\game -Directory | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; echo "Game pages \($\($pages.Count\)\): $\($pages -join ', '\)"; $sample = Get-Content _site\\game\\orbit\\index.html -Raw; echo "Orbit page loads core: $\($sample -match 'arcade/core\\.js'\) + game js: $\($sample -match 'arcade/orbit\\.js'\)")

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; $ok = 0; $bad = @\(\); foreach \($p in @\('game','game/debug-mode','game/loopback','game/breakpoint','game/trace-router','game/voltage-hop','game/solder-storm','game/overflow','game/signal-echo','game/short-circuit','game/bitshift','game/bug-patch','game/latency','game/keystroke','game/stack-jump','game/cable-run','game/surge','game/data-crossing','game/power-grid','game/xor','game/steady-hand','game/orbit'\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:4000/$p/" -UseBasicParsing; if \($r.StatusCode -eq 200\) { $ok++ } else { $bad += $p } } catch { $bad += $p } }; echo "OK: $ok / 22 | Failed: $\($bad -join ', '\)")
PowerShell(node --check assets\\js\\map.js; node --check assets\\js\\search.js; node --check assets\\js\\github-stats.js; echo "SYNTAX EXIT: $LASTEXITCODE")

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://api.github.com/users/Tristan-Bihler" -UseBasicParsing; $j = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; echo "GitHub user OK: $\($j.login\) — public repos: $\($j.public_repos\), followers: $\($j.followers\)" } catch { echo "GitHub API check failed: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; $ok=0; $bad=@\(\); foreach \($p in @\('','map/','search/','search.json','now/','uses/','projects/','game/'\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:4000/$p" -UseBasicParsing; if \($r.StatusCode -eq 200\) { $ok++ } else { $bad += $p } } catch { $bad += $p } }; echo "OK: $ok / 8 | Failed: $\($bad -join ', '\)")

PowerShell($idx = Get-Content _site\\index.html -Raw; echo "Skills section: $\($idx -match 'section-skills'\) | groups: $\(\([regex]::Matches\($idx, 'skill-card-head'\)\).Count\) | chips: $\(\([regex]::Matches\($idx, '<span class=""chip"">'\)\).Count\)")

PowerShell($pm = Get-Content _site\\photo-map.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; echo "photo-map.json: $\($pm.Count\) photos, exif: $\(@\($pm | Where-Object { -not $_.approx }\).Count\), thumbs exist: $\(@\($pm | Where-Object { Test-Path \('_site' + \($_.thumb -replace '/','\\'\)\) }\).Count\)"; $mp = Get-Content _site\\map\\index.html -Raw; echo "map page data-photos: $\($mp -match 'data-photos'\)"; $idx = Get-Content _site\\index.html -Raw; echo "favicon links: $\($idx -match 'favicon.svg'\) $\($idx -match 'favicon-32.png'\) $\($idx -match 'apple-touch-icon.png'\)"; echo "favicon files in _site: $\(Test-Path _site\\assets\\images\\favicon.svg\) $\(Test-Path _site\\assets\\images\\favicon-32.png\) $\(Test-Path _site\\assets\\images\\apple-touch-icon.png\)")

PowerShell(git log --oneline -5; git status --short | Measure-Object -Line | ForEach-Object { echo "uncommitted: $\($_.Lines\)" }; if \(Test-Path .github\\workflows\) { Get-ChildItem .github\\workflows | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name } else { echo "no workflows dir" })

PowerShell($size = \(Get-ChildItem _site -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\); echo \("_site: {0:N1} MB, {1} files" -f \($size.Sum/1MB\), $size.Count\); $tr = \(Get-ChildItem _site\\Travels -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\); if \($tr.Sum\) { echo \("Travels in _site: {0:N1} MB" -f \($tr.Sum/1MB\)\) })
